architectureDecisions: D1 — Canonical operational truth remains the existing Blackboard/application artifact/attempt/evidence stores plus delivered causal reconstruction. BB-072 adds a read-only DELIVERY_RUN_PROJECTION_V1 and operator control surface; it does not create a second canonical run database or let telemetry state authorize lifecycle transitions.

D2 — DELIVERY_RUN_PROJECTION_V1 is reconstructed from exact project/work/claimGeneration/executionAttemptId/binding/model/runtime/SCM/evidence refs and reports blocker/currentness state from authoritative sources. Missing provenance is UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED, never model-inferred.

D3 — Provider accounting is append-only per wire attempt. Cost, input/output/cache tokens and provider request identity remain nullable; failed/retried calls stay in totals; any missing usage remains UNKNOWN and can trigger conservative budget exhaustion but is never normalized to zero.

D4 — Budget control is explicit DELIVERY_BUDGET_POLICY_V1 with per-run hard ceilings for provider cost when known, token counts, model calls and wall time. Admission reserves known/maximum budget before dispatch; exhaustion blocks new dispatch, while cancellation requests route through the delivered execution/effect recovery authority instead of mutating attempt state directly.

D5 — Backup/restore for the supported single-tenant profile is a quiescent canonical-store snapshot plus MANIFEST_V1 of paths/digests/schema/release identity. Restore validates all digests and schema/release compatibility before replacing configured state; telemetry exports are excluded because loss of telemetry cannot grant or revoke acceptance.

D6 — Unknown external effects remain governed by the delivered Core/BB-058 reconciliation result. NON_RECONCILABLE/ambiguous effects stay blocked for operator action; the operations layer cannot mark them succeeded to make recovery convenient.

D7 — OpenTelemetry JS v2.11.0 is the selected optional export API for spans/metrics copied from canonical observations. OTLP export failure is diagnostic and cannot affect acceptance/currentness. The exporter is an adapter boundary that can target any compatible collector.

D8 — Langfuse v4.46.0 is retained only as an optional OTLP/trace inspection backend for operator experiments, not a required service or evidence authority. A minimal CLI is the supported v1 operator surface because diagnose/status/cancel/reconcile/backup/restore do not require an additional UI service.

D9 — Temporal v1.32.0 and Restate v1.7.11 are rejected as the canonical durability layer: existing ExHarness attempt/currentness/effect stores already own execution truth, and adding another workflow journal would create dual recovery authority.

D10 — Worker preflight requires BB-068 and BB-058 DONE and binds their exact SCM/CI provenance plus causal reconstruction/effect-reconciliation outputs. Incompatible delivered identity/recovery fields are PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

expectedDependencyOutputs: BB-068 DONE: exact repository/commit/CI/review identity and evidence refs exposed to delivery operations.
BB-058 DONE: exact causal reconstruction, blocker explanation and external-effect reconciliation/currentness seam used by the operator projection.

implementationSlices: S0 — Dependency preflight: require BB-068 and BB-058 DONE; bind exact SCM/CI and causal/reconciliation outputs and reject incompatible delivered identity fields.

S1 — Operator projection: implement DELIVERY_RUN_PROJECTION_V1 from authoritative refs only; expose exact blockers, task/attempt/model/runtime/SCM identities, currentness and evidence refs with UNKNOWN for missing observations.

S2 — Accounting/budget: implement append-only provider-attempt accounting and DELIVERY_BUDGET_POLICY_V1 admission/ceiling logic; keep failures/retries, nullable cost/tokens and conservative UNKNOWN handling.

S3 — Operator actions: implement CLI status/diagnose/cancel/reconcile using existing authority APIs. Cancellation/reconciliation cannot directly rewrite attempt/publication state and must surface ambiguous effects as blocked.

S4 — Durability: implement quiescent backup manifest, digest/schema/release validation and restore for configured canonical stores; prove process restart and restore reconstruct the same run projection while telemetry loss has no authority effect.

S5 — Telemetry adapter: export copy-only spans/metrics through OpenTelemetry JS v2.11.0-compatible APIs; prove exporter outage/loss cannot change canonical state. Optionally inspect with Langfuse v4.46.0 but keep it outside the supported authority boundary.

S6 — Operations probe: disconnect telemetry, exhaust each budget dimension, kill/restart the process, restore a backup and inject unresolved external effects; require truthful operator explanations and no fabricated zero usage.
S7 — Update Living truth with supported operator surface, retention/backup boundary, telemetry non-authority and known single-tenant limits.
